loan_products.description: Unsecured loan for personal financial needs — medical, travel, wedding, home renovation, etc.
loan_products.processing_fee: Up to 2% of loan amount + GST

eligibility.work_experience: Minimum 2 years, with at least 1 year in current job (salaried)

documents_salaried: KYC documents (Aadhaar / PAN / Passport / Voter ID)
Form 16 / IT returns for last 2 years
documents_self_employed: Last 2 years IT returns with computation

faqs.q: Can I get a personal loan without collateral?
faqs.a: Yes. Personal loans are unsecured — no collateral or guarantor is required.

faqs.q: How quickly is the loan disbursed?
faqs.a: For eligible applicants with complete documentation, disbursal can happen within 24–48 hours.

faqs.q: Can I prepay my personal loan?
faqs.a: Yes. Prepayment is allowed after 12 EMIs. A foreclosure charge of 2–5% of the outstanding principal may apply.

loan_products.description: Loan for purchasing, constructing, or renovating a residential property.
loan_products.ltv_ratio: Up to 90% of property value for loans up to ₹30 lakhs; up to 80% for higher amounts

eligibility.property: Must be in an approved location / RERA-registered project

documents: Property documents (sale deed / allotment letter / approved plan)

faqs.q: What is the maximum LTV ratio?
faqs.a: Up to 90% of property value for loans up to ₹30 lakhs, and up to 75–80% for higher loan amounts.

faqs.q: Can I apply jointly for a home loan?
faqs.a: Yes. Joint applications with a co-applicant (spouse or parent) are allowed and may improve loan eligibility.

faqs.q: Is there a tax benefit on home loans?
faqs.a: Yes. Under Section 80C (principal repayment up to ₹1.5L) and Section 24(b) (interest up to ₹2L) of the Income Tax Act.

loan_products.description: Loan for purchasing new or used two-wheelers and four-wheelers.
loan_products.processing_fee: Up to 1.5% of loan amount + GST
documents: Last 3 months salary slips or 2 years IT returns
Vehicle proforma invoice / RC (for used vehicles)

faqs.q: Can I get a loan for a used car?
faqs.a: Yes. Used vehicle loans are available for vehicles up to 10 years old, subject to valuation.

faqs.q: How much of the vehicle cost will be financed?
faqs.a: Up to 100% of the on-road price for new vehicles; 80–85% for used vehicles.

loan_products.description: Loan to fund higher education in India or abroad.
loan_products.moratorium: Course duration + 12 months (no repayment during study)
loan_products.processing_fee: Nil for loans up to ₹10 lakhs; 1% above that

eligibility.applicant: Student admitted to a recognised institution
eligibility.courses: Graduate, post-graduate, professional, and vocational courses

documents: KYC documents of student and co-applicant

faqs.a: Repayment begins after the moratorium period — course completion + 12 months or 6 months after getting a job, whichever is earlier.
Yes. Interest paid on education loans is deductible under Section 80E of the Income Tax Act for up to 8 years.

loan_products.description: Loan for working capital, business expansion, equipment purchase, or other business needs.
loan_products.processing_fee: Up to 2.5% of loan amount + GST
documents: Business proof (GST registration / incorporation certificate / trade licence)
Last 2 years IT returns with computation

faqs.q: Do I need collateral for a business loan?
faqs.a: Unsecured business loans are available up to ₹50 lakhs for eligible businesses. Higher amounts may require collateral.
Loans for businesses with less than 3 years of vintage are considered case-by-case under our startup lending programme.

general_faqs.q: How do I check my loan eligibility?
general_faqs.a: You can speak with me to get a preliminary eligibility check, or visit your nearest branch for a detailed assessment.

general_faqs.q: What is the CIBIL/credit score required?
general_faqs.a: A score of 700 and above is generally preferred. A higher score improves your chances and may get you a better interest rate.

general_faqs.q: How can I make my EMI payment?
general_faqs.a: EMIs are collected via ECS (auto-debit) from your registered bank account on the due date. You can also pay through net banking, UPI, or at a branch.

general_faqs.q: What happens if I miss an EMI?
general_faqs.a: A missed EMI attracts a late payment fee and may negatively impact your credit score. Please contact us as soon as possible if you anticipate a payment difficulty.

general_faqs.q: Can I foreclose my loan early?
general_faqs.a: Yes. Foreclosure is allowed after a minimum lock-in period (varies by loan type). A foreclosure charge of 2–5% may apply on floating-rate loans.

general_faqs.q: How do I apply for a loan?
general_faqs.a: You can start the application process right here by telling me the type of loan and amount you need. I will collect the initial details and a loan specialist will follow up.
